content: Listen to the secret sound, the sound that is all around. When you hear that sound, everything is clear.
author: Kabir
explanation: Beyond external noise and internal monologue lies the subtle vibration of pure existence (*Anahata Nada*). Attuning inward brings crystalline clarity to perception.
practicalInsight: Close your eyes and listen to the background of silence behind environmental noises for three minutes.
reflectionPrompt: Am I paying more attention to the noisy opinions of the world than to the quiet truth of silence?
